mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id, up.nickname, r.rating, r.content, r.atmosphere, r.created_at, r.image_url FROM reviews r JOIN user_profile up ON up.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.review_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(rating), 1), 0.0) AS average_rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS one_star_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS two_star_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS three_star_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS four_star_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS five_star_count FROM reviews WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT rv.review_id, up.nickname, rv.rating, rv.content, rv.atmosphere, rv.image_url, rv.created_at, rv.updated_at, m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category AS merchant_category, rs.id AS reservation_id, rs.reservation_code, rs.start_date AS reservation_start_date, rs.end_date AS reservation_end_date, tr.id AS transaction_id, tr.transaction_number, tr.amount AS transaction_amount, tr.approved_at AS transaction_approved_at FROM reviews rv JOIN user_profile up ON up.user_id = rv.user_id JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rv.merchant_id LEFT JOIN reservations rs ON rs.id = rv.reservation_id LEFT JOIN transactions tr ON tr.id = rv.transaction_id WHERE rv.review_id = #{reviewId} AND rv.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT rv.review_id, m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category AS merchant_category, m.thumbnail_url AS merchant_thumbnail_url, rv.rating, rv.content, rv.atmosphere, rv.image_url, rv.created_at, rv.updated_at, rv.reservation_id, rv.transaction_id FROM reviews rv JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rv.merchant_id WHERE rv.user_id = #{userId} AND rv.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY FIELD(m.category, 'ACCOMMODATION', 'OFFICE', 'RESTAURANT', 'ACTIVITY'), rv.created_at DESC, rv.review_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
